verdict.rationale: Guidance content on www.uscis.gov was evidently readable: file-online, filing-fees, tools and G-28 pages are all quoted, and robots.txt there was read (Crawl-delay 10 honored). But the same probe got HTTP 403 for a standard-UA agent at www.uscis.gov/llms.txt. The public case-status host egov.uscis.gov sits behind a Cloudflare challenge that 403s even robots.txt, so part of the public reading surface is bot-walled. Missing for 10: a direct probe confirming guidance pages return 200 to an identified keyless UA; no Cloudflare/bot wall on egov.uscis.gov; no 403 on www paths such as llms.txt.
